title: Federal active emotion calculating method for heterogeneous data

pse.problem: Non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) data, unbalanced label distribution in federated learning for affective computing, high labeling cost
pse.solution_function: Federated active emotion computing method (FAL) aims to select the most beneficial samples from the unlabeled data set, pass them to an Oracle (human annotator) for labeling, and update the shared global model using federated averaging algorithm (FEDAVG), while maintaining performance and reducing labeling cost
pse.solution_structure: Local devices with local datasets, global model, federated averaging algorithm (parameters of local models are merged to update the shared global model)
pse.solution_implementation: FAL uses a disagreement-based approach to build a committee of local models, select data points that cause significant disagreement among the committee members for labeling, and update the global model using FEDAVG
pse.effect: Improved emotion classification performance, reduced labeling cost while maintaining privacy in federated learning frameworks
